title_zh: 分别确认两个分部的资料数量

scenario.label_zh: 分别确认两个分部的文件数量与负责人
scenario.goal_zh: 核对各分部对应的份数并约定分别领取并送往各自分部

context_zh: 同事 Clara 与 Austin 为东西两个分部准备培训资料；Clara 负责东部，Austin 负责西部。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: The East and West branches need six and eight copies respectively. Have I matched those correctly?

sentences.speaker: Austin
sentences.text: Yes. I'll take eight to West, and you'll take six to East.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Let's keep the packets separate so our respective teams get the right number.

sentences.speaker: Austin
sentences.text: I'll label both packets before we collect them.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll check the East label when I pick mine up.

targets.sense_zh: 分别地；按所列顺序各自地
